title: Turkish Kunefe Cheesecake
description: A twist on the traditional Turkish kunefe dessert, this cheesecake combines the crispy phyllo with a creamy cheese filling.
instructions: Thaw phyllo dough according to package instructions.
In a bowl, mix together kunefe cheese, sugar, and pistachio syrup.
Brush melted butter on each phyllo piece.
Place one phyllo piece in the bottom of a springform pan.
Spread half of the cheese mixture on top of the phyllo.
Repeat the layers: phyllo, cheese mixture, phyllo, and finally the remaining cheese mixture.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until golden brown.
Drizzle with additional pistachio syrup, if desired.
